Keynote Talk

10:55–11:25 CST

AI for Healthcare: From Biomedical Signals to Medical Imaging

Tânia Pereira · University of Porto · INESC TEC

Biography

Tania Pereira is an Assistant Professor at the University of Porto and a Senior Researcher at INESC TEC, Portugal. She received her PhD in Biomedical Engineering from the University of Coimbra, Portugal, in 2014. Throughout her academic career, she has gained international research experience through postdoctoral positions and collaborations with multidisciplinary teams, which has contributed to her development as an independent researcher. Her research lies at the intersection of artificial intelligence, biomedical engineering, and healthcare, with a particular focus on biomedical signal processing, medical image analysis, and machine learning. Her work spans non-invasive cardiovascular monitoring and AI-based lung cancer characterization using CT imaging. She has been actively involved in national and international research projects, fostering interdisciplinary collaborations between engineering, computer science, and clinical research. Her academic journey reflects a commitment to advancing healthcare technologies, building international research networks, and mentoring the next generation of researchers.
